outputs.discrepancies: Caption states that co-expression of HMGB1-GFP reduced the accumulation of MitoTracker Deep Red in Atxn1(86Q)-DsRed-transfected cells, but the images show the opposite: the Atxn1-86Q-DsRed column (without HMGB1-GFP) shows sparse/reduced MitoTracker Deep Red signal (consistent with mitochondrial dysfunction caused by mutant Atxn1), while the Atxn1-86Q-DsRed;HMGB1-GFP column shows a much stronger, restored MitoTracker Deep Red signal comparable to the Empty-DsRed control. The visual data thus indicate that HMGB1-GFP co-expression restores/increases MitoTracker accumulation rather than reducing it, contradicting the caption wording (and also being inconsistent with the panel's stated purpose of showing HMGB1 'restoring mitochondrial functions').
